name: Sharp-lobed hepatica
desc: Sharp-lobed hepatica (Hepatica acutiloba): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 8 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Hepatica acutiloba, the sharp-lobed hepatica, is a herbaceous flowering plant in the buttercup family Ranunculaceae. It is sometimes considered part of the genus Anemone, as Anemone acutiloba, A.
